disclosures.estimate: An estimate from the provider's published pricing. The quotation on the provider's own checkout is the amount you actually pay.
disclosures.main: Broka does not operate these escrow services and does not hold, receive or release your money. The services are provided independently by their respective operators. Broka does not guarantee their performance or independently control their funds. Review the provider's current fees, conditions, refund policy and dispute procedures before paying.
points: Each provider has its own terms and privacy policy. Read them before you use it.
When you use a provider you enter into a separate agreement with it, not with Broka.
A provider's protection applies only according to that provider's own rules.
Broka cannot guarantee that a dispute will end in a refund.
Open the provider's official website yourself, or follow Broka's exact approved https link. Never use a link, paybill, till or phone number someone sends you in a chat.
relationship: Broka is not a party to your transaction with the provider and has no control over its funds.
Broka lists providers to help you compare them. A listing is information, not a recommendation and not a promise about how the provider will behave.
Broka cannot recover money held by, or sent through, a provider, and cannot decide a dispute that the provider is handling.

Details are taken from the provider's own public pages and checked by Broka on the date shown. Providers can change them at any time: the provider's own checkout is the authority on what you will pay.
